title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A young woman with short purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose, holding a massive purple warhammer with both hands. She wears a white and purple cropped top with matching pants, armored gauntlets, and greaves, all accented with lightning bolt patterns.
